title: Homestead Exemption
questionText: Shall the existing additional $2,000 homestead exemption from Gwinnett County School District ad valorem taxes for education purposes for certain public service employees be expanded to also apply to disabled veterans and all employees of the Gwinnett County School District and the Buford City School District?
quote:
Homestead Exemption 

Exención por vivienda familiar 

(Vote for One / Vote por uno) 

Shall the existing additional $2,000 

homestead exemption from Gwinnett 

County School District ad valorem taxes 

for education purposes for certain public 

service employees be expanded to also apply 

to disabled veterans and all employees of 

the Gwinnett County School District and the 

Buford City School District? 

¿Debería ampliarse la actual exención 

de vivienda familiar de $2,000.00 de los 

impuestos ad valorem para fines educativos 

del Distrito Escolar del Condado de Gwinnett 

para ciertos emple ados de servicios 

públicos para que también se expanda y 

beneficie a los veteranos discapacitados y a 

todos los empleados del Distrito Escolar del 

Condado de Gwinnett y del Distrito Escolar 

de la Ciudad de Buford? 

Yes / Sí 

No 

Abbreviation Definition / Definición de abreviatura: 

(I)(T) = Incumbent, Titular 

Rep = Republican, Republicano 

Dem = Democrat, Demócrata
scopeNote: Exact unnumbered English question in the current November 3 county consolidated sample. HB540 identifies the electorate as electors of the Gwinnett County school district, not all county voters or all Buford school district voters. The signed act originally names the 2026 general-primary date; it is used here for the exact district electorate only. Current official November sample controls this packet’s election date.

title: City of Suwanee — Homestead Exemption
questionText: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Suwanee ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in the amount of $15,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city?
quote: Shall the Act be approved which provides a homestead exemption from City of Suwanee ad valorem taxes for municipal purposes in the amount of $15,000.00 of the assessed value of the homestead for residents of that city?
scopeNote: Exact sole question on the official November 3, 2026 city special-election sample, independently administered by Suwanee. The specimen prints no separate question number or title; this descriptive display title identifies the city homestead subject. Whole City of Suwanee electorate, not all Gwinnett County. Native city endpoint 403; complete official PDF reader capture 200 retained distinctly.
